issues.description: The segment clone and slice contracts require `rc + 1 < REF_COUNT_MAX`, rejecting the valid boundary `rc = REF_COUNT_MAX - 1` even though the execution saturation guard permits the increment to `REF_COUNT_MAX`.
issues.rationale: At `rc = REF_COUNT_MAX - 1`, the execution-side `MetaSlot::inc_ref_count` guard `last_ref_cnt >= REF_COUNT_MAX` is false, so incrementing to exactly `REF_COUNT_MAX` is permitted. The selected embedding instead requires `rc + 1 < REF_COUNT_MAX`, which is false at that boundary and makes `Op::SegmentClone`, `Op::SegmentSlice`, their step proofs, and the embedded clone axiom strictly stronger than the execution behavior. Repair commit a6d4cd2c17a43ecf9c5a435d9dc2b6e41c9c6efe changes each affected inequality to `<=` and explicitly documents that it matches the execution saturation guard.
issues.source_evidence: after/ostd/specs/mm/embedding/mod.rs:1127-1144 requires both SegmentClone and SegmentSlice frames to satisfy `ref_count.value() + 1 < REF_COUNT_MAX`. after/ostd/specs/mm/embedding/segment.rs:378-387 repeats the strict inequality in `segment_clone_embedded`. In the same selected snapshot, after/ostd/src/mm/frame/meta.rs:744-764 specifies and implements `MetaSlot::inc_ref_count`: it permits old counts below REF_COUNT_MAX and panics only when `last_ref_cnt >= REF_COUNT_MAX`. Repair commit a6d4cd2c17a43ecf9c5a435d9dc2b6e41c9c6efe changes all clone/slice inequalities from `<` to `<=` and notes that this is equivalent to `rc < REF_COUNT_MAX`.
